Ministry of Agriculture () is a government ministry in North Korea which is responsible for Democratic People's Republic of Korea's agriculture. It was formed in September 1948.
Main tasks
The Ministry of Agriculture of the DPRK plays a central role in formulating and implementing policies aimed at increasing the country's food security and self-sufficiency.
Transformation into the State Commission for Agriculture.
In 2022, the Ministry of Agriculture of the DPRK was reorganized and elevated to the status of the State Commission for Agriculture. This move likely indicates increased centralized control and the prioritization of agricultural development in the face of persistent food problems in the country. The commission is currently headed by Ri Cheol-man, who also serves as Deputy Prime Minister of the Cabinet.
The DPRK Ministry of Agriculture today
In recent years, the DPRK has implemented new management systems such as the "Field Responsibility System" and the "Farm Responsibility Management System" to improve productivity. The North Korean Ministry of Agriculture faces challenges in providing sufficient mechanization for agricultural production, leading to a significant reliance on manual labor.
